audience: Swedish and Finnish businesses and bookkeepers who keep their books in Briox

useCases.title: Find overdue customer invoices
useCases.text: List the customer invoices with status overdue, and check their open amounts. Open one invoice to read its rows, payment state and reminders.

useCases.title: Review supplier invoices of a period
useCases.text: List the supplier invoices for a date range, with their payment status. Open one invoice to read its rows, linked files and deviations.

useCases.title: Look up a voucher in the ledger
useCases.text: List the financial years, then the journals of one series. Open a journal to read all its debit and credit rows, and list the accounts they use.

useCases.title: Check bank balances and project status
useCases.text: Read the balances of the company's bank accounts. List the projects with their leader, status and dates.

useCases.title: Add a customer and an item
useCases.text: List the customers to find a customer number that is not in use. Create the customer, then create the item for a product or service.

useCases.title: Prepare an invoice for review
useCases.text: Find the customer and the items. Then create a customer invoice with at least one row. It is saved unposted, so you post and send it in Briox.
